blocks.en: 4.0 Introduction to the Regulatory Framework

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: PACMP (Post-Approval Change Management Protocol，上市後變更管理計畫)： 在初次申請上市許可（NDA/BLA/MAA）時，主動在 CTD 中預先聲明未來可能執行的 reprocessing 步驟及其可接受標準。審查機關預先審核後，日後若實際發生，僅需 Annual Report（AR）或 CBE 層級即可，而非 PAS。這是主動規劃、降低未來監管負擔的核心策略。
blocks.en: PACMP (Post-Approval Change Management Protocol): when first applying for marketing authorization (NDA/BLA/MAA), reprocessing steps that may be performed in the future, and their acceptance criteria, are declared proactively in the CTD. After the authority has reviewed them in advance, if reprocessing actually occurs later, only an Annual Report (AR) or CBE-level filing is needed, rather than a PAS. This is the core strategy of proactive planning to reduce future regulatory burden.

blocks.zh: CTD（Common Technical Document，通用技術文件）：ICH M4 規範的全球統一申請格式，Module 3 為 CMC 資料，是 reprocessing 協議主要存放位置。
blocks.en: CTD (Common Technical Document): the globally harmonized submission format defined by ICH M4. Module 3 contains the CMC data and is the main place where the reprocessing protocol is held.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: PACMP 就像建築師在設計圖審查時，就先取得「未來改建預審許可」。房子蓋好後若按圖改建，不用再重新申請建照，只需備案。若未事先審查就擅自改建，則需完整重新審查（= PAS）。在生物製劑 reprocessing 上，這個時間差可能意味著數月甚至一年的延誤。
blocks.en: A PACMP is like an architect obtaining a "pre-approval for future renovation" while the design drawings are being reviewed. After the house is built, renovations that follow the approved drawings need no new building permit application, only a filing. If the owner renovates without prior review, a full re-review is required (= PAS). For biologicals reprocessing, this time difference can mean months or even a year of delay.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: ICH 協調框架的核心效益：同一套 PACMP 可同時支援 FDA BLA 及 EMA MAA 申請，大幅降低 CDMO 在多市場服務 Sponsor 時的文件重工量。台灣 TFDA 接受 PIC/S 標準，而 PIC/S 主要參照 EMA 架構——因此 PACMP 設計時應以 EMA 要求為基準，確認 FDA 兼容性。
blocks.en: The core benefit of the ICH harmonized framework: one PACMP can support both an FDA BLA and an EMA MAA, greatly reducing the documentation rework for a CDMO serving Sponsors in multiple markets. Taiwan's TFDA accepts PIC/S standards, and PIC/S mainly follows the EMA framework. Therefore a PACMP should be designed using EMA requirements as the baseline, and FDA compatibility then confirmed.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.en: If a Sponsor asks the CDMO to establish a reprocessing protocol already at the Phase 3 IND stage, how does this relate to the timing of a PACMP?

blocks.en: Which subsection of CTD Module 3 is most suitable for placing the reprocessing protocol? (Hint: 3.2.S or 3.2.P)

blocks.zh: 4.2 Regulatory Guidance 法規指引（ICH 指引彙整）
blocks.en: 4.2 Regulatory Guidance (Summary of ICH Guidelines)

blocks.zh: ICH Q7 的重要區分：「製程步驟尚未完成時繼續執行」≠ reprocessing。例如：過濾尚未達到目標流量，繼續過濾屬正常製程；但若過濾失敗後重新過濾（refiltration），則屬 reprocessing。此區分對無菌充填步驟的 CDMO 至關重要。
blocks.en: An important distinction in ICH Q7: "continuing to perform a process step that has not yet been completed" ≠ reprocessing. For example, if filtration has not yet reached the target flow, continuing to filter is normal processing; but refiltration after a filtration failure is reprocessing. This distinction is critical for CDMOs performing sterile filling steps.

blocks.zh: Concurrent Validation（同步驗證）：不等待三批完整驗證批次，而是在 reworking 批次生產同時執行驗證。適用於一次性或極少數批次的 rework 情境，但需要預先定義接受標準。
blocks.en: Concurrent validation: instead of waiting for three complete validation batches, validation is performed at the same time as the reworked batch is produced. It is suitable for one-off or very few rework batches, but the acceptance criteria must be defined in advance.

blocks.zh:
ICH Q7 對 reprocessing vs. 正常製程的區分，就像餐廳廚師：
• 牛排還沒熟，繼續烤 → 正常製程（non-reprocessing）
• 牛排煎焦了，切除焦皮重新調味 → reworking
• 牛排快焦時取出冷卻後再烤 → reprocessing（若事先定義在 SOP 中則可接受）
blocks.en:
The ICH Q7 distinction between reprocessing and normal processing is like a restaurant chef:
• The steak is not yet cooked, so keep grilling → normal processing (not reprocessing)
• The steak is burnt, so cut off the charred crust and re-season → reworking
• The steak is about to burn, so take it off, let it cool, and grill it again → reprocessing (acceptable if defined in an SOP beforehand)

blocks.zh: 過期 API 的 reprocessing（ICH Q7 Q&A）：技術上可行，但必須同時滿足：(1) 完整 GMP 歷史紀錄、(2) 額外穩定性數據、(3) 確認是否需要補充申報。台灣 CDMO 若為 Sponsor 提供此類服務，務必在 QTA 中明確責任歸屬——申報義務仍在 MAH（上市許可持有人），不在 CMO。
blocks.en: Reprocessing of expired API (ICH Q7 Q&A): technically feasible, but the following must all be met: (1) a complete GMP history record, (2) additional stability data, and (3) confirmation of whether a supplementary filing is needed. If a Taiwan CDMO provides this kind of service for a Sponsor, responsibility must be clearly assigned in the QTA: the filing obligation remains with the MAH (marketing authorization holder), not with the CMO.

blocks.zh: ICH Q13 與連續製造：隨著 CM 技術導入生物製劑，過濾失敗後的 refiltration 策略需在 CPMP（Continuous Process Monitoring Plan）中預先定義，不可事後補救。
blocks.en: ICH Q13 and continuous manufacturing: as continuous manufacturing (CM) technology is introduced for biologicals, the refiltration strategy after a filtration failure must be predefined in the CPMP (Continuous Process Monitoring Plan) and cannot be remedied after the fact.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh:
台灣某 CDMO 在批量配製後的無菌過濾（sterile filtration）發生 integrity test 失敗。此情況下：
(1) 若 BLA 或 PACMP 中已有預先核准的 refiltration 協議 → 屬 reprocessing（approved protocol），申報層級較低（AR 或 CBE）
(2) 若無預先核准協議 → 屬 reprocessing without approved protocol → PAS 層級（需 FDA 批准後才能放行）
決策原則：Sterility（無菌保證）優先 → 不確定時必須向 Regulatory Authority 確認
blocks.en:
At a Taiwan CDMO, the integrity test fails after sterile filtration of a bulk compounded batch. In this situation:
(1) If a pre-approved refiltration protocol already exists in the BLA or PACMP → it is reprocessing (approved protocol), with a lower reporting category (AR or CBE)
(2) If there is no pre-approved protocol → it is reprocessing without an approved protocol → PAS level (FDA approval required before release)
Decision principle: sterility assurance comes first → when uncertain, confirm with the regulatory authority

blocks.zh: 依 ICH Q9(R1)，如何利用 Quality Risk Management 決定某批 reprocessing 的可接受性？
blocks.en: Under ICH Q9(R1), how can quality risk management be used to decide whether the reprocessing of a given batch is acceptable?

blocks.zh: 若 reprocessing 發生在「大多數批次」，ICH Q7 如何要求處理？為何這對 BLA 申報有重大影響？
blocks.en: If reprocessing occurs in "most batches," how does ICH Q7 require this to be handled? Why does this have a major impact on the BLA submission?

blocks.zh: Table 4.2-1 Regulatory Guidance on Reprocessing/Reworking — ICH Guidelines 法規指引彙整
blocks.en: Table 4.2-1 Regulatory Guidance on Reprocessing/Reworking — ICH Guidelines

blocks.zh: 台灣 CDMO 解讀：ICH Q7 適用於 Drug Substance（API）製造；ICH Q9(R1) 提供風險決策框架；ICH Q13 針對連續製造中的過濾管理。生物製劑 Drug Product 的 sterile filtration 屬 ICH Q7 原則延伸應用。
blocks.en: Interpretation for Taiwan CDMOs: ICH Q7 applies to drug substance (API) manufacture; ICH Q9(R1) provides the risk decision framework; ICH Q13 addresses filtration management in continuous manufacturing. Sterile filtration of biological drug product is an extended application of ICH Q7 principles.

blocks.zh: 4.3 Specific Guidance from the United States (FDA) 美國 FDA 特定指引
blocks.en: 4.3 Specific Guidance from the United States (FDA)

blocks.zh: IND Information Amendment（IND 資訊修正案）：在臨床試驗期間，若製造過程發生 reprocessing 或 reworking，需向 FDA 提交 21 CFR 312.31 資訊修正案。重點：無強制等待期，但業界慣例是等待 FDA 審閱機會再繼續。這不同於上市後 PAS 的強制等待。
blocks.en: IND Information Amendment: during clinical trials, if reprocessing or reworking occurs in the manufacturing process, an information amendment under 21 CFR 312.31 must be submitted to FDA. Key point: there is no mandatory waiting period, but industry practice is to allow FDA an opportunity to review before continuing. This differs from the mandatory wait for a post-approval PAS.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 601.12 三層申報架構：
blocks.en: The three-tier reporting structure of 21 CFR 601.12:

blocks.zh: PAS（Prior Approval Supplement）= 大幅變更，需等待 FDA 批准（通常 6–12 個月）
blocks.en: PAS (Prior Approval Supplement) = major change; FDA approval must be awaited (usually 6–12 months)

blocks.zh: CBE-30 = 中度變更，提交後等待 30 天即可放行
blocks.en: CBE-30 = moderate change; release is possible 30 days after submission

blocks.zh: AR（Annual Report）= 輕微變更，年度報告時一併揭露
blocks.en: AR (Annual Report) = minor change; disclosed together in the annual report

blocks.zh:
關鍵裁定：無預先核准協議 = PAS
依 1997 年 FDA 指引，reprocessing without a previously approved protocol 直接歸類為 PAS。這是實務上最常見的陷阱：CDMO 在緊急情況下執行 refiltration，若 BLA 未包含此協議，即觸發 PAS——批次必須扣留至 FDA 批准。
對策：PACMP 預先涵蓋所有預期 reprocessing 步驟。
blocks.en:
Key ruling: no pre-approved protocol = PAS
Under the 1997 FDA guidance, reprocessing without a previously approved protocol is classified directly as a PAS. This is the most common practical trap: if a CDMO performs refiltration in an emergency and the BLA does not contain this protocol, a PAS is triggered, and the batch must be held until FDA approval.
Countermeasure: cover all anticipated reprocessing steps in advance through a PACMP.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application — 台灣 CDMO 服務美國 Sponsor

blocks.zh: 場景：台灣 CDMO 執行 BLA 商業批生產，無菌過濾後 integrity test 失敗，執行 refiltration。
blocks.en: Scenario: a Taiwan CDMO is producing a commercial BLA batch; the integrity test fails after sterile filtration, and refiltration is performed.

blocks.en: Scenario

blocks.zh: 決策優先順序：Sterility（無菌保證）→ CQA → Business。若過濾失敗批次無菌性存疑，廢棄優先於申請 PAS 放行。
blocks.en: Decision priority: sterility assurance → CQA → business. If the sterility of a batch with a filtration failure is in doubt, rejection takes precedence over applying for PAS release.

blocks.zh:
PAS / CBE-30 / AR 就像建築改建許可：
• PAS = 大型結構變更，需完整重新審查建照（等待核准才能動工）
• CBE-30 = 中型內部裝修，30 天後若無異議即可動工
• AR = 小型修繕，年底統一申報備案即可
CDMO 的工作就是在設計階段（PACMP）就把所有「可能要做的裝修」預先納入建照，避免緊急時面對 PAS 的漫長等待。
blocks.en:
PAS / CBE-30 / AR are like building renovation permits:
• PAS = major structural change; a full re-review of the building permit is needed (wait for approval before starting work)
• CBE-30 = medium interior renovation; work may start after 30 days if there is no objection
• AR = minor repair; just file it with the year-end report
The CDMO's job is to include all the "renovations that may be needed" in the permit at the design stage (PACMP), so as to avoid facing the long PAS wait in an emergency.

blocks.zh: TFDA 對應說明
blocks.en: TFDA Interpretation

blocks.zh: 台灣 TFDA 法規對於製造場址位於台灣的 CDMO，主要參照 PIC/S GMP 規範（EMA 架構），但若 Sponsor 為美國廠商且申請 FDA BLA，則批次申報義務依 21 CFR 601.12 執行，由 MAH（BLA holder，通常為 Sponsor）承擔。CDMO 需在 QTA（品質技術協議）中明確規定：發生 reprocessing 時，CDMO 需在多少工作天內通知 Sponsor，以便 Sponsor 決定申報類別。
blocks.en: For a CDMO whose manufacturing site is in Taiwan, TFDA regulations mainly follow the PIC/S GMP requirements (EMA framework). However, if the Sponsor is a US company applying for an FDA BLA, the batch reporting obligations are carried out under 21 CFR 601.12 and borne by the MAH (the BLA holder, usually the Sponsor). The CDMO must specify clearly in the QTA (Quality Technical Agreement) within how many working days the CDMO must notify the Sponsor when reprocessing occurs, so that the Sponsor can decide on the reporting category.

blocks.zh: 為何 reworking（相對於 reprocessing）在 FDA 2021 年指引的 CBE-30 或 AR 欄位中顯示 "N/A"？這代表什麼含義？
blocks.en: Why does reworking (as opposed to reprocessing) show "N/A" in the CBE-30 or AR columns of the 2021 FDA guidance? What does this mean?

blocks.zh: 4.4 Specific Guidance from the European Union (EMA) 歐盟 EMA 特定指引
blocks.en: 4.4 Specific Guidance from the European Union (EMA)

blocks.zh: IMPD（Investigational Medicinal Product Dossier，試驗性醫療產品檔案）：等同於 FDA IND 的歐盟對應文件。臨床試驗期間，若製造過程發生 reprocessing，需評估是否構成 "substantial modification"；若是，需向成員國主管機關申報。
blocks.en: IMPD (Investigational Medicinal Product Dossier): the EU equivalent of the FDA IND. During clinical trials, if reprocessing occurs in the manufacturing process, it must be assessed whether it constitutes a "substantial modification"; if so, it must be notified to the competent authorities of the Member States.

blocks.zh: EMA Variation Regulation 三層分類：
blocks.en: The three-tier classification of the EMA Variation Regulation:

blocks.zh: Type II（重大變更）≈ FDA PAS
blocks.en: Type II (major change) ≈ FDA PAS

blocks.zh: Type IB（次要變更）≈ FDA CBE-30
blocks.en: Type IB (minor change) ≈ FDA CBE-30

blocks.zh: Type IA（微小變更）≈ FDA AR（但時間規定不同：12 個月內申報）
blocks.en: Type IA (minimal change) ≈ FDA AR (but with different timing: to be notified within 12 months)

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — EMA 對 Reworking 的態度
blocks.en: Key Notes — EMA's Position on Reworking

blocks.zh: EMA 指引（2022 臨床期 + Variation Regulation 商業期）均完全不提及 reworking。這並非疏漏，而是 EMA 立場：生物製劑的 reworking 被視為不可接受或極端例外，預設要求 case-by-case 洽詢 EMA，無標準化申報路徑。
blocks.en: The EMA guidance (the 2022 clinical-phase guideline and the Variation Regulation for the commercial phase) does not mention reworking at all. This is not an oversight but the EMA position: reworking of biologicals is regarded as unacceptable or an extreme exception, and the default is to require case-by-case consultation with EMA, with no standardized reporting pathway.

blocks.zh: 相較之下，FDA 2021 年指引雖也對 reworking 列出 N/A，但至少在表格中明確呈現，暗示需個案評估。EMA 連提都不提，代表其態度更為保守。
blocks.en: By comparison, the 2021 FDA guidance also lists N/A for reworking, but at least shows it explicitly in the table, implying that case-by-case evaluation is needed. EMA does not mention it at all, indicating a more conservative attitude.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — EMA vs. FDA 文化差異
blocks.en: Analogy — Cultural Differences between EMA and FDA

blocks.zh: FDA 對 reprocessing/reworking 的態度較為「工程導向」：只要有充分數據支持，就可以找到一條申報路徑。EMA 較為「預防原則導向」：生物製劑的 reworking 幾乎等同於重新生產，preferably avoided。
blocks.en: FDA's attitude toward reprocessing/reworking is more "engineering-oriented": as long as sufficient data support it, a reporting pathway can be found. EMA is more "precautionary-principle-oriented": reworking of a biological is almost equivalent to remanufacturing and is preferably avoided.

blocks.zh: 台灣 CDMO 同時服務 FDA 和 EMA 市場時，應以 EMA 較嚴格的立場為設計基準——若能通過 EMA 的 "exceptional circumstances" 要求，FDA 端通常也可接受。反之則不然。
blocks.en: When a Taiwan CDMO serves both the FDA and EMA markets, it should use the stricter EMA position as the design baseline: if the EMA "exceptional circumstances" requirement can be met, FDA can usually accept it as well. The reverse is not true.

blocks.en: Notified after implementation, similar to AR

blocks.en: Per PIC/S equivalence

blocks.en: Refer to EMA Type IA/IB

blocks.en: TFDA follows PIC/S, leaning toward the EMA framework

blocks.zh: TFDA 說明：台灣 TFDA 藥品 CMC 申報主要依 PIC/S Annex 1 及相關 EMA 指引，對 reprocessing 申報採 EMA 類比框架。若 CDMO 同時持有 Taiwan 藥品許可，應另行確認 TFDA 個案要求。
blocks.en: TFDA note: TFDA CMC filings for medicinal products mainly follow PIC/S Annex 1 and the relevant EMA guidance, and take an EMA-analogous framework for reprocessing reporting. If the CDMO also holds a Taiwan drug license, the case-specific TFDA requirements should be confirmed separately.

blocks.zh: EMA 2022 指引將 Drug Substance reprocessing 限定於 "exceptional circumstances"，而 FDA 允許以協議預先核准。這對 CDMO 的 reprocessing 開發策略有何影響？
blocks.en: The 2022 EMA guideline limits drug substance reprocessing to "exceptional circumstances," whereas FDA allows pre-approval through a protocol. How does this affect a CDMO's reprocessing development strategy?

blocks.zh: 若某批次在臨床期間（IMPD 已提交）需要 reprocessing，如何判斷是否構成 EMA 定義的 "substantial modification"？
blocks.en: If a batch needs reprocessing during the clinical phase (IMPD already submitted), how do you determine whether it constitutes a "substantial modification" as defined by EMA?

Manufacturing process of the active substance: any reprocessing not described in the IMPD
原料藥製造過程中：IMPD 未載明的任何 reprocessing
blocks.en: Manufacturing process of the active substance: any reprocessing not described in the IMPD

blocks.zh:
Manufacturing process of the active substance: reprocessing if adequately described and accepted in the initial submission
原料藥製造過程中：已在初始提交中充分描述且獲接受的 reprocessing
blocks.en: Manufacturing process of the active substance: reprocessing if adequately described and accepted in the initial submission

blocks.zh:
解讀：IMPD 中有描述 = 非重大修正（免申報）；IMPD 中無描述 = 重大修正（需申報）。與 FDA 邏輯一致：事先在申請案中納入協議，可大幅降低事後申報負擔。
資料來源：EMA Guideline on Requirements for Quality Documentation — Biological IMPs in Clinical Trials, Revision 2 (2022)
blocks.en:
Interpretation: described in the IMPD = non-substantial modification (no report needed); not described in the IMPD = substantial modification (report needed). This is consistent with the FDA logic: including the protocol in the application in advance greatly reduces the later reporting burden.
Source: EMA Guideline on Requirements for Quality Documentation — Biological IMPs in Clinical Trials, Revision 2 (2022)

重要說明：EMA Variation Regulation 完全未提及 reworking——代表 EMA 無標準化 reworking 申報路徑，任何 reworking 均需個案洽詢 EMA Scientific Advice。
比較鍵：B.I.a.2(c) 針對 Drug Substance；B.II.b.3(c) 針對 Drug Product（需 comparability assessment）。台灣 CDMO 若需執行 DS 或 DP reprocessing，應評估是否觸發 comparability study 要求。
資料來源：EMA Variation Regulation, Annex II; PDA TR74 (Revised 2026), Table 4.4.2-1
blocks.en:
Important note: the EMA Variation Regulation does not mention reworking at all, meaning EMA has no standardized reworking reporting pathway, and any reworking requires case-by-case consultation through EMA Scientific Advice.
Comparison keys: B.I.a.2(c) applies to drug substance; B.II.b.3(c) applies to drug product (comparability assessment required). If a Taiwan CDMO needs to perform DS or DP reprocessing, it should assess whether a comparability study requirement is triggered.
Source: EMA Variation Regulation, Annex II; PDA TR74 (Revised 2026), Table 4.4.2-1

blocks.zh: 4.5 Other Guidance 其他法規指引（WHO / PIC/S / BioPhorum / PDA）
blocks.en: 4.5 Other Guidance (WHO / PIC/S / BioPhorum / PDA)

blocks.zh: PIC/S（Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-Operation Scheme）：目前有 57 個成員監管機構，包括 TFDA（台灣）、TGA（澳洲）、Health Canada 等。PIC/S GMP Guide 主要跟隨 EMA GMP 指引架構，並定期與 EMA Annex 同步更新。因此，TFDA GMP 要求本質上與 EMA 高度一致。
blocks.en: PIC/S (Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-Operation Scheme): currently has 57 member regulatory authorities, including TFDA (Taiwan), TGA (Australia), Health Canada, and others. The PIC/S GMP Guide mainly follows the structure of the EMA GMP guidelines and is regularly updated in step with the EMA Annexes. TFDA GMP requirements are therefore essentially highly consistent with those of the EMA.

blocks.zh: PIC/S 非法規機構，無法律約束力，但其成員機構彼此承認 GMP 查廠結論（Mutual Recognition），大幅降低重複稽查負擔。
blocks.en: PIC/S is not a regulatory authority and has no legal force, but its member authorities mutually recognize each other's GMP inspection conclusions (mutual recognition), greatly reducing the burden of duplicate inspections.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 黃金準則
blocks.en: Key Notes — The Golden Rule

blocks.zh: 本節結尾的 Note 是全章最重要的操作原則：
blocks.en: The Note at the end of this section is the most important operating principle of the whole chapter:

blocks.zh: 「若 reprocessing 或 reworking 未在已提交的製造過程文件中明確提及，應正確假設其尚未獲批准。」
blocks.en: "If reprocessing or reworking is not specifically mentioned in the submitted manufacturing process documentation, it should be correctly assumed that it has not been approved."

blocks.zh: 這意味著：沉默 ≠ 允許。在不確定時，必須聯繫主管機關確認，而非逕行執行並事後報告。CDMO 在接受 Sponsor 授權前，應確認 BLA/MAA/IND 中是否已有明確的 reprocessing 條款。
blocks.en: This means: silence ≠ permission. When in doubt, the authority must be contacted for confirmation, rather than proceeding and reporting afterwards. Before accepting a Sponsor's authorization, the CDMO should confirm whether the BLA/MAA/IND already contains explicit reprocessing provisions.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application — TFDA 與全球 Sponsor 的交集
blocks.en: Practical Application — The Intersection of TFDA and Global Sponsors

blocks.zh: 台灣 CDMO 的監管三角：
blocks.en: The regulatory triangle of a Taiwan CDMO:

blocks.zh: TFDA（台灣藥品申請）→ PIC/S GMP，參照 EMA 架構
blocks.en: TFDA (Taiwan drug applications) → PIC/S GMP, following the EMA framework

blocks.zh: FDA（美國 Sponsor BLA）→ 21 CFR 601.12，三層申報制
blocks.en: FDA (US Sponsor BLA) → 21 CFR 601.12, three-tier reporting system

blocks.zh: EMA（歐洲 Sponsor MAA）→ Variation Regulation，Type II/IB/IA
blocks.en: EMA (European Sponsor MAA) → Variation Regulation, Type II/IB/IA

blocks.zh:
實務建議： 1. QTA（品質技術協議）中應明確規定：哪些事件構成 reprocessing，CDMO 的通知義務時限（建議 3–5 工作天），以及由哪方承擔申報責任（通常為 MAH/Sponsor）。
2. CDMO 的 Site Master File（SMF）應包含 reprocessing 的一般框架政策，避免逐一 Sponsor 重複協商。
3. BioPhorum 發布的 reprocessing 最佳實務文件可作為 SOP 撰寫的技術參考。
blocks.en:
Practical recommendations: 1. The QTA (Quality Technical Agreement) should specify which events constitute reprocessing, the time limit for the CDMO's notification obligation (3–5 working days recommended), and which party bears the reporting responsibility (usually the MAH/Sponsor).
2. The CDMO's Site Master File (SMF) should include a general framework policy on reprocessing, to avoid renegotiating with each Sponsor one by one.
3. The best-practice documents on reprocessing published by BioPhorum can serve as a technical reference for writing SOPs.

blocks.zh:
WHO / PIC/S / BioPhorum 就像國際外送平台（Uber Eats）的評分與規則：
• FDA = 美國市場的法律（強制性）
• EMA = 歐盟市場的法律（強制性）
• PIC/S = 國際 GMP 標準（準強制性，因為成員機構相互承認）
• WHO / BioPhorum = 業界最佳實踐建議（非強制，但具重要參考價值）
台灣 CDMO 同時在 FDA 和 EMA 這兩個「市場」服務客戶，必須同時遵守兩套法律，並以 PIC/S 標準確保自身 GMP 狀態。
blocks.en:
WHO / PIC/S / BioPhorum are like the ratings and rules of an international food delivery platform (Uber Eats):
• FDA = law of the US market (mandatory)
• EMA = law of the EU market (mandatory)
• PIC/S = international GMP standard (quasi-mandatory, because member authorities recognize each other)
• WHO / BioPhorum = industry best-practice recommendations (not mandatory, but of significant reference value)
A Taiwan CDMO that serves customers in both the FDA and EMA "markets" must comply with both sets of laws, and use PIC/S standards to ensure its own GMP status.

blocks.zh: TFDA 基於 PIC/S 成員身份，在 reprocessing 申報上最接近 EMA 還是 FDA 的框架？為何此了解對台灣 CDMO 的 Sponsor 溝通至關重要？
blocks.en: As a PIC/S member, is TFDA's reprocessing reporting closest to the EMA or the FDA framework? Why is this understanding critical for a Taiwan CDMO's communication with Sponsors?

blocks.zh: BioPhorum 和 PDA 的指引（非法規義務）在實務上何時應優先參考？
blocks.en: When should BioPhorum and PDA guidance (not regulatory obligations) be consulted first in practice?

blocks.zh: 若某東南亞市場（非 ICH 成員）的 Sponsor 要求台灣 CDMO 執行 reworking，應如何建立申報策略？
blocks.en: If a Sponsor in a Southeast Asian market (not an ICH member) asks the Taiwan CDMO to perform reworking, how should the reporting strategy be established?

blocks.zh: 決策優先順序（TR74 核心原則）：無菌保證（Sterility Assurance）→ 關鍵品質屬性（CQA）→ 商業考量（Business）。任何 reprocessing/reworking 決策均需遵守此優先順序；若無菌性存疑，廢棄批次優先於申請任何層級的申報。
blocks.en: Decision priority (TR74 core principle): sterility assurance → critical quality attributes (CQA) → business considerations. Every reprocessing/reworking decision must follow this order of priority; if sterility is in doubt, rejecting the batch takes precedence over applying for any category of reporting.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: ICH 協調框架：PACMP 是預先核准 reprocessing 的黃金工具，可將事後申報從 PAS 降至 AR/Type IA，是 CDMO 設計階段最重要的策略。
blocks.en: ICH harmonized framework: the PACMP is the golden tool for pre-approving reprocessing; it can lower after-the-fact reporting from PAS to AR/Type IA and is the most important strategy for a CDMO at the design stage.

blocks.zh: FDA 三層架構：無協議 = PAS（批次扣留至核准）；有協議 = AR；Reworking = N/A（個案洽詢）。關鍵依據：21 CFR 601.12 及 FDA 1997/2021 年指引。
blocks.en: FDA three-tier structure: no protocol = PAS (batch held until approval); with protocol = AR; reworking = N/A (case-by-case consultation). Key basis: 21 CFR 601.12 and the 1997/2021 FDA guidance.

blocks.zh: EMA 三層架構：無協議重大 reprocessing = Type II（需核准）；有協議低風險 = Type IA（12 個月內申報）；Reworking 完全未提及（比 FDA 更保守）。
blocks.en: EMA three-tier structure: major reprocessing without a protocol = Type II (approval required); low-risk with a protocol = Type IA (notify within 12 months); reworking is not mentioned at all (more conservative than FDA).

blocks.zh: TFDA 定位：PIC/S 成員，主要跟隨 EMA 架構。台灣 CDMO 在 QTA 中應明確 reprocessing 通知義務時限與申報責任歸屬。
blocks.en: TFDA positioning: a PIC/S member, mainly following the EMA framework. A Taiwan CDMO should specify in the QTA the time limit for reprocessing notification and the allocation of reporting responsibility.

blocks.zh: 黃金準則：「文件未提及 = 未核准」。在不確定時，聯繫主管機關優先於任何製造決策。
blocks.en: Golden rule: "not mentioned in the documents = not approved." When in doubt, contacting the authority takes precedence over any manufacturing decision.

blocks.zh: 決策優先順序：無菌保證 → CQA → Business。若無菌性存疑，廢棄優先於申報放行。
blocks.en: Decision priority: sterility assurance → CQA → business. If sterility is in doubt, rejection takes precedence over reporting for release.
